description:
Thermotec E-Flex HT is a
high-performance, flexible closed-cell EPDM rubber foam pipe insulation
specifically engineered for solar hot water, HVAC, and high-temperature plumbing
systems. Designed with outstanding UV resistance, it withstands outdoor
weathering and sun exposure for many years without cracking, embrittlement, or
deterioration. It operates at continuous temperatures from -57°C up to +150°C
(with intermittent peak exposure up to 175°C - 180°C), preventing thermal energy
loss and solar line overheating.

Self-extinguishing to ASTM D 635 and non-flammable to JIS K 6911

Green Star
and ODP-EMI4 compliant with zero ozone-depleting substances

Available in
standard 2m lengths, continuous coils, and multiple wall thicknesses

rag_summary:
Thermotec
E-Flex HT is an Australian-supplied, high-temperature EPDM closed-cell rubber
foam pipe insulation specifically engineered for solar hot water and HVAC
systems. Built with outstanding UV and weather resistance, it withstands outdoor
rooftop exposure without cracking or degrading, operating continuously from
-57°C to +150°C (with intermittent peaks to 180°C). Delivering an in-situ
R-value of R0.38 in 13mm wall thickness (exceeding NCC/AS 3500.4 mandates) and
fire-tested to AS 1530.3 (flame spread 0), it protects solar lines against
extreme thermal loss, freezing, and sun degradation.

description:
Thermotec Rockwool Pipe
Insulation is a heavy-duty, pre-formed mineral wool pipe lagging engineered for
industrial and commercial pipework carrying high-temperature fluids and steam at
continuous temperatures up to 650°C. Manufactured from non-combustible volcanic
rock fibres with a nominal density of 115 to 140 kg/m³, it is factory-laminated
with a reinforced aluminium foil facing to act as a vapour barrier and protect
against moisture ingress. It delivers exceptional thermal insulation and
acoustic noise attenuation on steam lines, boilers, high-pressure hot water, and
exhaust systems.

rag_summary:
Thermotec Rockwool Pipe Insulation is a heavy-duty, foil-faced pre-formed stone
wool pipe lagging designed for high-temperature commercial and industrial

description:

underfloor insulation engineered to replace traditional bulk insulation and

green anti-glare coating), it delivers an in-situ thermal break of up to R0.25

patented 150mm foil overlap flap, effectively manages condensation, and reduces
acoustic rain and airborne noise by up to 12 dB.

install:
Ensure steel stud flange or purlin surface
is clean, dry, and free from oil, grease, or dust

Install pliable wall wrap
or roof sarking over the steel framing in accordance with AS/NZS 4200.2

Peel
back the protective release liner from the self-adhesive backing of the thermal
break strip

Press the strip firmly along the steel stud or purlin face,
ensuring continuous adhesive contact

Butt consecutive 1200mm strips tightly
end-to-end along the entire length of the framing member

Fasten exterior
cladding, battens, or roofing directly through the strip into the steel frame
selection_checklist:
Confirm requirement for self-adhesive
peel-and-stick backing for faster installation

Verify project requires
AS 1530.1 non-combustible compliance for steel frames

Measure total linear
meterage of framing to calculate pack requirement (60 lineal metres per pack)

Ensure cladding screws have sufficient length to account for the 10mm strip
thickness
limitations:
Non-structural spacer; cladding fasteners must penetrate through strip into
steel frame

Steel substrate must be clean and dry to ensure proper adhesive
grab

Cladding should be installed without prolonged delay to protect the
assembly

rag_summary:
Trade Select NC
Thermal Break Strips Adhesive Backed (by Ametalin) are 10mm x 45mm x 1200mm
non-combustible thermal break strips equipped with a peel-and-stick high-tack
adhesive backing. Classified as Not Deemed Combustible under AS 1530.1 and
delivering an in-situ R0.24 thermal break, they allow fast, one-person
installation onto steel studs and roof purlins without slipping or blowing away
in wind. Fully compliant with NCC Volume One and Two requirements for
non-combustible construction and BAL-FZ bushfire zones, they provide an
efficient, code-compliant thermal break.
